purpose: Read-only diagnostic search beyond the official Milestone 2B.16 top-10 evaluation; not used in official metrics.

results.question: In what language must borrower communications be provided under this fair-practice code?

gold_references.title: Fair Practice Code (Version 7.1)
gold_references.section_title: 4. Applications for loans and their processing
gold_references.evidence_snippet: All communications to the borrower shall be in the vernacular language or a language as understood by the borrower.
gold_references.reference_notes: The page gives the borrower's language comprehension as the alternative to the vernacular.

results.question: What key loan information must Bajaj Finance convey in writing when a loan is sanctioned?

gold_references.title: Fair Practice Code (Version 7.1)
gold_references.evidence_snippet: The Company will convey in writing to the borrower in the vernacular language by means of sanction letter or otherwise, the amount of loan sanctioned along with the terms and conditions including annualised rate of interest and method of application thereof
gold_references.reference_notes: This supports the sanctioned amount, terms, annualised rate, and rate-application method.

results.question: Where must penal charges for late repayment or another borrower default be highlighted?

gold_references.title: Fair Practice Code (Version 7.1)
gold_references.evidence_snippet: The Company will mention the penal charge which will be charged for late repayment and / or any other default on the part of the customer, in bold in the loan agreement.
gold_references.reference_notes: The code specifies the loan agreement and bold presentation.

results.question: Where must Shriram Finance explain how it grades borrower risk and why different rates are charged?

gold_references.title: Fair Practice Code 2023
gold_references.section_title: 1) Applications for loans and their processing
gold_references.evidence_snippet: The loan application form and the sanction letter issued to the customer shall disclose the approach for gradation of risks and rationale for charging different rates of interest to different categories of borrowers and the same shall also be made available on the web-site of the Company or published in the relevant newspapers.
gold_references.reference_notes: The code names the application form, sanction letter, website, or relevant newspapers as disclosure locations.

results.question: What governance duties does Shriram Finance's board have for grievance handling and Fair Practice Code compliance?

gold_references.title: Fair Practice Code 2023
gold_references.evidence_snippet: Such a mechanism shall ensure that all disputes arising out of the decisions of Company’s functionaries are heard and disposed of at least at the next higher level. (b) The Board of Directors shall also provide for periodical review of the compliance of the FPC
gold_references.reference_notes: The provision assigns the board responsibility for the mechanism, next-level review of disputes, and periodic FPC/grievance reviews.
